LESSON: READING FOR FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Reading for Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Fluency, part of Reading in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can reading fluency be achieved? 22 ● simulate conversations from word prompts about languages spoken in turns (e.g. 你会说什么语言?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read informal and polite greetings from flashcards as peers respond in turns (您 好 nín hǎo, 您贵姓 nín guìxìng, 你姓什 么 nǐ xìng shénme, 下午好 xiàwǔ hǎo, 很高兴认识您 hěn gāoxìng rènshí nín, etc.),

2. read out simple passages on introduction of self and others by name, age, origin, residence and languages spoken (e.g. 你 们好! 我姓王,叫丽丽。我今年 13 岁。我来自中国。我和家人住在内罗 毕。),

3. read names of various languages and match them to their English equivalents collaboratively ( e.g. 英语 Yīngyǔ- English, 法语 Fǎyǔ- French, 德语 Déyǔ- German, 斯瓦西里语 Sīwǎxīlǐyǔ- Swahili),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read informal and polite greetings from flashcards as peers respond in turns (您 好 nín hǎo, 您贵姓 nín guìxìng, 你姓什 么 nǐ xìng shénme, 下午好 xiàwǔ hǎo, 很高兴认识您 hěn gāoxìng rènshí nín, etc.),
2. read out simple passages on introduction of self and others by name, age, origin, residence and languages spoken (e.g. 你 们好! 我姓王,叫丽丽。我今年 13 岁。我来自中国。我和家人住在内罗 毕。),
3. read names of various languages and match them to their English equivalents collaboratively ( e.g. 英语 Yīngyǔ- English, 法语 Fǎyǔ- French, 德语 Déyǔ- German, 斯瓦西里语 Sīwǎxīlǐyǔ- Swahili),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: the learner develops teamwork skills as they take turns to simulate conversations based on

word prompts.

Values:
• Unity: this is developed as the learner collaborates with their peers to rearrange jumbled up words to form correct sentences

on self-introduction.

• Respect: the learner exhibits positive regards for self and others when they address them appropriately in formal contexts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural awareness: the learner develops effective cross-cultural communication skills when they search for customs related to

greetings and introductions in Kenya and China.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links their learning to English and Kiswahili on the use of appropriate words to express courtesy and respect in

different contexts.
